# Transcriptomics

Preserve the requested method, contrast, identifiers, enrichment source, and
statistical population. These are parts of the estimand, not interchangeable
output formats.

## Differential Expression

- Match count-matrix sample IDs to metadata before fitting. Confirm the design
  formula, covariates, reference and target levels, and contrast direction.
- Use raw counts for count-model methods unless the named method specifies a
  different input. Do not treat normalized or transformed abundance as counts.
- Use the matched experimental control. Do not replace a vehicle, batch-matched,

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import gc, time
import pandas as pd
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

start=time.time()
meta=pd.read_csv('inputs/Sample_annotated_Zenodo.csv')
count_by_gene=pd.read_csv('inputs/BatchCorrectedReadCounts_Zenodo.csv', index_col=0)
counts=count_by_gene.T
counts.index.name='sample'
del count_by_gene
gc.collect()
meta=meta.set_index('sample').loc[counts.index].copy()
meta['batch']=pd.Categorical(meta['batch'].astype(str), categories=['1','2','3','4'])
meta['sex']=pd.Categorical(meta['sex'], categories=['F','M'])
print('loaded', counts.shape, 'elapsed', round(time.time()-start,2), flush=True)

dds=DeseqDataSet(
    counts=counts,
    metadata=meta,
    design='~ batch + sex',
    refit_cooks=True,
    n_cpus=8,
    low_memory=True,
)
print('design columns', list(dds.obsm['design_matrix'].columns), flush=True)
print('design rank', dds.obsm['design_matrix'].shape, flush=True)
dds.deseq2()
print('fit elapsed', round(time.time()-start,2), flush=True)
stat_res=DeseqStats(dds, contrast=['sex','M','F'], n_cpus=8)
stat_res.summary()
print('LFC columns', list(stat_res.LFC.columns), flush=True)
print('FAM138A unshrunk', stat_res.results_df.loc['FAM138A'].to_dict(), flush=True)
stat_res.lfc_shrink(coeff='sex[T.M]')
row=stat_res.results_df.loc['FAM138A']
print('FAM138A shrunk', row.to_dict(), flush=True)
print('passes thresholds', bool(abs(row['log2FoldChange'])>0.5 and row['baseMean']>10), flush=True)
print('final elapsed', round(time.time()-start,2), flush=True)
PY"

import gc, time
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

start=time.time()
path='inputs/BatchCorrectedReadCounts_Zenodo.csv'
hdr=pd.read_csv(path, nrows=0)
dtypes={c:np.int32 for c in hdr.columns[1:]}
gene_by_sample=pd.read_csv(path, index_col=0, dtype=dtypes)
nonzero=gene_by_sample.sum(axis=1)>0
print('genes total/nonzero/allzero',len(nonzero),int(nonzero.sum()),int((~nonzero).sum()),flush=True)
counts=gene_by_sample.loc[nonzero].T
del gene_by_sample, nonzero, hdr, dtypes
gc.collect()
counts.index.name='sample'
meta=pd.read_csv('inputs/Sample_annotated_Zenodo.csv').set_index('sample').loc[counts.index].copy()
meta['batch']=pd.Categorical(meta['batch'].astype(str), categories=['1','2','3','4'])
meta['sex']=pd.Categorical(meta['sex'], categories=['F','M'])
print('loaded',counts.shape,'dtype',counts.dtypes.iloc[0],'elapsed',round(time.time()-start,2),flush=True)

dds=DeseqDataSet(counts=counts, metadata=meta, design='~ batch + sex', refit_cooks=True,
                 n_cpus=1, low_memory=True)
print('design columns',list(dds.obsm['design_matrix'].columns),flush=True)
del counts,meta
gc.collect()
dds.deseq2()
print('fit elapsed',round(time.time()-start,2),flush=True)
stat_res=DeseqStats(dds, contrast=['sex','M','F'], n_cpus=1)
stat_res.summary()
print('LFC columns',list(stat_res.LFC.columns),flush=True)
print('FAM138A unshrunk',stat_res.results_df.loc['FAM138A'].to_dict(),flush=True)
stat_res.lfc_shrink(coeff='sex[T.M]')
row=stat_res.results_df.loc['FAM138A']
print('FAM138A shrunk',row.to_dict(),flush=True)
print('passes thresholds',bool(abs(row['log2FoldChange'])>0.5 and row['baseMean']>10),flush=True)
print('final elapsed',round(time.time()-start,2),flush=True)
